title: LAPD Operation Firewall Press Conference 5/21/26
description:
Five counties in Southern California and 112 affiliate law enforcement agencies are uniting to protect local children from dangerous online predators. LAPD Chief Jim McDonnell announced the major regional crackdown alongside federal, state, and local partners in Operation Firewall. Key leaders included U.S. Attorney Bill Essayli, District Attorney Nathan Hochman, HSI Special Agent Eddy Wang, and Sheriff Don Barnes.

Law enforcement officers conducted undercover work and served warrants across five Southern California counties. The historic crackdown focused heavily on identifying predators on social media and gaming platforms. These collaborative efforts successfully rescued 40 children from abuse and resulted in 341 arrests. Social services like the Department of Children and Family Services immediately stepped in to provide trauma care to the victims.

This press conference highlights the impact of this operation.
